strengthThreshold.description: Topic is a Strength when more than 50% of answers are grade A with at least 3 questions attempted.

opportunityThreshold.description: Topic is an Opportunity when grade B share is 40% or more, indicating correct knowledge but poor decision-making.

weaknessThreshold.description: Topic is a Weakness when grade D share is 30% or more.

threatThreshold.description: Topic is a Threat when grade C share is 40% or more, indicating guessing or inconsistency.
